# Alliance Canada HPC for Machine Learning

> The Digital Research Alliance of Canada provides HPC clusters with NVIDIA GPUs (H100, A100, V100, T4, P100) for Canadian ML researchers. This documentation covers cluster access, Slurm GPU job submission, Python environments, PyTorch/TensorFlow setup, distributed training, experiment tracking, and large-scale ML workflows.

Key facts for ML researchers:
- Job scheduler: Slurm — use `sbatch` with `--gres=gpu:1` (or gpu:a100:4, etc.)
- Python: use `module load python` then `virtualenv`, NOT Anaconda/Conda
- Install packages: `pip install --no-index torch torchvision` (uses pre-built wheels)
- Storage: scratch (fast, purged after 60 days), project (persistent, shared), $SLURM_TMPDIR (node-local SSD)
- GPU clusters: Narval (A100), Trillium (H100), Cedar/Graham/Béluga (V100/P100/T4)
- Distributed training: DeepSpeed, PyTorch DDP, Horovod all supported
- Containers: Apptainer (Singularity) for custom environments
- Track experiments: W&B, MLflow, Comet.ml, TensorBoard all work

## Cluster Specifications

- [National systems](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/National_systems): Overview of all national systems
- [Trillium](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Trillium): 1224 CPU + 63 GPU nodes (H100 80GB), 29PB NVMe — U of T
- [Narval](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Narval): GPU nodes with A100 80GB — ETS Montreal
- [Cedar](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Cedar): GPU nodes (P100, V100) — SFU
- [Graham](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Graham): GPU nodes (P100, V100, T4) — U of Waterloo
- [Beluga](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Beluga): GPU nodes (V100 32GB) — ETS Montreal
- [Fir](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Fir): New cluster at SFU with GPUs
- [Nibi](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Nibi): New cluster with GPUs
- [Rorqual](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Rorqual): New cluster at ETS Montreal
- [Killarney](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Killarney): New cluster
- [Vulcan](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Vulcan): New cluster
- [Niagara](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Niagara): 80k CPU cores for large parallel jobs — U of T
- [Mist](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Mist): Power9 + V100 GPUs — SciNet
- [Arbutus](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Arbutus): Cloud with GPU instances — UVic
- [Trillium Quickstart](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Trillium_Quickstart): Trillium-specific quick start
- [Niagara Quickstart](https://docs.alliancecan.ca/wiki/Niagara_Quickstart): Niagara-specific quick start
